subject: Commit classification ambassador onboarding and rollout plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer, marissa_cole, ben_carter, priyom_das
Cc: 
Date: 2027-03-05T08:12:00Z
Subject: Commit classification ambassador onboarding and rollout plan

Team —

Thanks for making time this week. I want to lock in a lightweight 'ambassador' program so a small set of experienced AEs can make final calls on Commit vs Best Case vs Pipeline for borderline deals, and run short calibration sessions for the rest of the team. Goals: keep forecast noise low, reduce mid-quarter reclassifications, and give Finance a consistent signal for cash planning.

Proposed approach (first pass):
- Pilot window: 3 weeks (Mar 15–Apr 4) with 8 ambassador accounts across US region.
- Ambassadors: Karthik, Marissa, Ben (volunteer/nominate others).
- Deliverables: one 30-min calibration + live review of 6 deals per week; writeups for ambiguous cases; an annotated spreadsheet with Commit/Best Case mapping rules.
- Reporting: weekly digest to Finance (BI + short examples).

I've attached a rough mapping doc to iterate (commit_mapping_v1.pdf). Please reply with: (1) any red flags, (2) 3 accounts you'd like to pilot, and (3) availability for a 30-min kickoff (week of Mar 8).

Also tagging Priyom because CS / customer impact rules may affect our guidance on multi-product deals.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

--- attachment: commit_mapping_v1.pdf (summary table + examples) ---

- Preference for kickoff: Mar 9 or Mar 10, afternoons PST.

I'll add brief deal notes to the attached pilot_account_list.csv and flag two that I think need special treatment (multi-cloud discounting + contract staging).

To: naomi_feldman, karthik_iyer, ben_carter, priyom_das
Date: 2027-03-05T10:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Commit classification ambassador onboarding and rollout plan

Happy to help as an ambassador — I can cover weekday mornings PST. A couple of design suggestions from a rollout + enablement perspective:

1) Make the calibration session prescriptive: 20 min guided scoring (each deal gets a short rubric) + 10 min Q&A. Keep a public scoreboard of examples (anonymized).
2) Create an "Escalation tag" in the CRM for deals where Contract wording or procurement timing changes expected closing date; ambassadors can add a short justification.
3) For training material, short micro-lessons (3–5 slides + 2 examples) are easier to consume than a single long doc.

I added three accounts to pilot_account_list.csv and flagged one (Novara Systems) that may need CS input. Priyom — can you confirm whether the Novara deal has staged billing that would alter commit recognition?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

- Kickoff: Mar 10, 15:00–15:30 PST — calendar invite sent (link below).
- Weekly reviews: Wednesdays 14:00–14:30 PST (first run Mar 17).

Sophie / Acme procurement — I'm copying you so you have visibility into the internal cadence for how we'll classify Acme in the forecast while we finalize their contract. If you prefer we avoid public mentions of deal details in the weekly digest, reply and we'll mark Acme as redacted in summaries.

Naomi
